issue_title: run-all: enforce per-suite timeout portably on macOS
problem_statement:
run-all: enforce per-suite timeout portably on macOS

## Problem

`scripts/tests/run-all.sh` documents `--timeout SECONDS` as a per-suite timeout with a 600-second default, but `run_limited()` only enforces it when a `timeout` executable happens to be on `PATH`. macOS does not ship GNU `timeout`, so the option silently becomes unbounded rather than failing closed or using a portable watchdog.

Observed while verifying #255 on 2026-08-29:

- `command -v timeout` returned no executable on the Mac runner;
- the full suite accepted the default timeout configuration but ran for about 87 minutes;
- individual suites included roughly 20-minute and 23-minute runs, both well beyond the advertised 600-second limit;
- the run ultimately passed, so this is not a #255 correctness failure, but it is a false bounded-completion contract for local and unattended runs.

Relevant implementation: `scripts/tests/run-all.sh:700-705` falls through to an ordinary unbounded `"$@"` invocation when `timeout` is unavailable.

## Sprint contract

- [ ] Enforce a non-zero `--timeout SECONDS` on supported macOS and Linux hosts without requiring an undeclared GNU coreutils installation.
- [ ] Never silently convert a requested/default timeout into an unbounded run. If the portable watchdog cannot start, fail before running suites with a clear remediation.
- [ ] Preserve `--timeout 0` as the explicit opt-out.
- [ ] Preserve the existing timed-out disposition and report (`timed out after <N>s`) without misclassifying ordinary suite exit codes.
- [ ] Terminate the timed-out suite and its descendants so a timeout does not leave background workers holding files, ports, locks, or credentials.
- [ ] Add deterministic fixtures covering: timeout utility absent, a suite exceeding the limit, a suite completing inside the limit, exit-code preservation, `--timeout 0`, descendant cleanup, and invalid timeout values.
- [ ] Keep Bash 3.2 compatibility for the shell entrypoint and avoid network/runtime installation during the gate.
- [ ] Run focused timeout/toolchain tests plus the full repository gate with zero failed and zero quarantined, followed by exact-head independent review.

## Affected area

- `scripts/tests/run-all.sh`;
- a small portable watchdog helper if needed;
- focused run-all/toolchain fixtures and `scripts/README.md` inventory if a helper is added.

## Dependencies

No open dependencies. #255 closed through PR #259 and current-main `sensors` passed at the merge commit. The defect does not depend on #255.s implementation.

## Tier

B — the current interface falsely promises bounded completion and can strand unattended lanes, but it does not alter production data, authorization, money, consent, or release topology.

## Non-goals

- shortening legitimate suite work or weakening tests to fit the limit;
- installing GNU coreutils as a hidden prerequisite;
- changing the 600-second default in this repair;
- treating a timeout as success or quarantine.

test_ids: scripts/tests/wall-timeout.test.sh::missing portable runtime fails before suites with remediation
